content: अभ्युदय {%a.%} Rising. .{@-यः@} .²1 Rise (of heavenly bodies); sunrise. .²2 Rise, prosperity, good fortune, elevation, success; स्पृशन्ति नः स्वामिनमभ्युदयाः <ls>Ratn. 1</ls> success; भवो हि लोकाभ्युदयाय तादृशाम् <ls>R. 3. 14</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 254</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 63</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 3</ls>; <ls>V. 5</ls>. .²3 A festival; any religious or festive celebration, festive occasion; ˚कालः joyous or festive occasion; <ls>Ś. 7</ls>; प्रतिषिद्धा पिबेद्या तु मद्यमभ्युदयेष्वपि <ls>Ms. 9. 84</ls>. .²4 Beginning, commencement. .²5 Occurrence, happening. .²6 Accomplishment of a desired object (which is the cause of festivity). .²7 The {%tonsure%} ceremony. .²8 A Śrāddha performed on account of child-birth (वृद्धिश्राद्धम्)
